Gold mining: ten villagers on four gold tiles

Prototype model using the supplied game data. Reference comparison only; current DE crowd behavior has not been validated.

Green: mining · Blue: returning to gold · Orange: carrying to camp. Worker labels show ID and carried gold. Map grid is in tiles.

Reference and sustained rates

CaseGold/villager/min
Forgotten Empires, no bumping29.27
One worker, completed delivery cycles29.24
Ten workers, walking only28.07
Ten workers, collisions enabled27.06

Ten-worker rates count deposited gold plus the change in carried gold over 120–420 seconds. The reference excludes crowding. Deposited gold at a deadline is shown separately.

Blue: deposited gold · Gold: deposited plus carried. Vertical line marks the selected time.

Baseline inputs: work 0.50255 gold/s; movement 0.968 tiles/s; radius 0.20 tiles; carry 20. One empty tile between gold and camp.

Explicit model choices: rigid villagers, visibility routing, immediate deposit at contact, continuous mining, and 0.5-second retries when blocked. No fitted congestion multiplier.
